questions.question: Who led a revolt against David after Absalom's death?
How was Sheba's revolt ended?
options: Joab's men battered down the city wall and stormed inside
The townspeople threw open the gates and fled in great fear
He surrendered himself up to David's army at the break of dawn
A wise woman arranged for his head to be thrown over the wall
questions.answer: A wise woman arranged for his head to be thrown over the wall
